entries.268439a94d3f9444: This business manufactures and sells press dies and surface grinders. Dies are also used for component production within the group, and revenue from external customers was ¥4,112 million in the fiscal year ended January 2026.
entries.31ca4376f01fccac: This business manufactures and sells motor core products and other items.
